Dwarflings Update 1.1.0
Dwarflings Update 1.1.0
Dwarflings Update 1
notes.notes:
First update is available for download! We listened for your feedback and it was was really helpful. Thank you! Besides minor improvements and bug fixes, in this update you will find:

Game speed
Now you can choose game speed from slow to really fast, using arrow button at the top-right corner of the screen.

Game difficulty
We added three difficulty levels, which you can choose in the Settings menu.
Shaveling (Easy)

 Pause available
 You can give orders during pause
 Used items will be restored if you will replay the level

Beardie (Normal)

 Pause available
 You can't give orders during pause
 Used items will be restored if you will replay the level

Greybeard (Hard)

 Pause disabled
 Used items will not be restored if you will replay the level
 You will earn much more score


Starwind Games Team
